To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(1) a pseudogene or Ha‐ras— related sequence maps to a region of chromosome 2, 30 cM from the telomere, and (2) a functional Ha‐ras sequence maps to the distalmost region of chromosome 1.

(i) The functional mouse Ha‐ras sequence is located at 40 cM from the telomere on mouse chromosome 2, and (ii) the sequence previously mapped to this region of the mouse chromosome is a pseudogene or a Ha‐ras— related sequence.
the functional Ha‐ras locus maps to the distroal end of mouse chromosome 7 and that a pseudogene or related sequence is located in the central region of mouse chromosome 8.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the genetic analysis of mouse models for human cancer.
the molecular genetics of cancer in mice and the role of genetic alterations in the development of cancer.
the analysis of the genetic alterations in rodentine tumors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the functional Ha‐ras maps to the distalmost region of mouse chromosome 7, approximately 50 cM from the telomere.
the functional mouse Ha‐ras maps to the distalmost region of chromosome 6.
the functional Ha‐ras locus maps to the distalmost 10% of the distal arm of mouse chromosome 7.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Ha‐ras locus is 30 cM from the distromere, 1 cM from the telomere, and 1 cM distal to the locus for the H‐2 complex.
the mouse Ha‐ras pseudogene has been located on mouse chromosome 2, and that the functional Ha‐ras locus maps to the distoal region of mouse chromosome 7.
the functional Ha‐ras sequence is located on the centromeric side of the centromere on chromosome 7.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the mouse Ha‐ras locus is more distal on chromosome 7 than previously reported and that this is an important consideration in the analysis of genetic alterations of the Ha‐ras locus in rodent tumors, especially when interspecific crosses are used.
the Ha‐ras pseudogene is not a good marker for the functional gene.
, in the mouse, the Ha‐ras oncogene maps to the distalmost region of chromosome 2 (7 in humans).
